dicom_pixel_data.statement: Pixel data is never read, never stored and never analysed. Apiome imports DICOM's metadata layer — the file meta information, the attribute structure and Structured Report content trees — and steps over every Pixel Data, Float Pixel Data, Double Float Pixel Data and Overlay Data value by its declared length without decoding it. Each one is recorded as present and skipped, with its VR and length, so its absence from the model is stated, not implied.

dicom_values.statement: No attribute value is in this model: patient names, identifiers, dates, UIDs and report text are payload. The model holds each attribute's tag, keyword, VR and multiplicity; values are only in the native analysis, under the value-visibility policy (presence and length by default).
